narrative: A player's roll opened on the book-keeper's desk behind the arras. A fair secretary hand that is not yours. Cue-words ranged right after a long rule, the speech under it. The name at the head is Gaunt. One surface.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read his own lines in another hand.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Named by the copy. Not pictured.

entities.name: Richard the Second
entities.context: Shown on part in Gaunt, in another man's hand
